name: Grave of the First Wake
introDiscord:
Beyond the remembering scale, the graveyard changes.

No wrecks.

No traveler camps.

No newer bones.

Only one skeleton.

It stretches farther than you can see, half-buried beneath ancient
sediment while enormous ribs disappear into darkness overhead.

Every current in Leviathan's Wake begins here.

You have reached the Grave of the First Wake.

grave-of-the-first-wake-approach.prompt:
Three paths cross beneath the oldest known Leviathan ribs. Their surface
has been worn smooth by ages of current, and tiny luminous creatures
drift through them like stars inside a ruined sky.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's final trail cache.

For once, the pouch contains no ridiculous diagram.

Only a note:

'We made it.

I don't know how old this place is.

Glimmer has been quiet since we arrived.

Me too.'

right.message:
An ancient offering hollow rests beneath the first rib.

There is no lock.

No wreckage.

No sign anyone owned it.

Travelers from different ages simply left gifts here.

Among them, you find Star Candies still glowing softly beneath the
sediment.

forward.message:
Light gathers between the ribs.

A Gravekeeper takes shape from old current and fragments of bone—not
angry, but unwilling to let you pass without proving you belong here.

grave-of-the-first-wake-depths.prompt:
The path follows a vertebral column so enormous each section forms its
own hill. Three routes wind between bones older than every map of the
Astral Sea.

left.message:
Another Gravekeeper rises from the ancient current.

Behind it, the enormous skeleton seems to stretch forever.

right.message:
A warm current rises through a hollow in the first spine.

Shizuki left her final restorative bottle beside Glimmer's tiny glowing
mark.

Her note reads:

'We rested here for a long time.

You should too.

Some places deserve more than rushing through them.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave Shizuki's final restorative untouched.

The warm current is enough.

forward.message:
A hollow vertebra contains offerings left across centuries:

shells.

old coins.

carved stars.

tiny charms.

and Star Candies from travelers whose names are long gone.

Nobody stole them.

This place seems to have always been treated differently.

grave-of-the-first-wake-threshold.prompt:
The final three paths enter the immense ribcage.

The current passing through the bones creates a low sound—not quite the
Last Leviathan Song, but something older beneath it.

left.message:
At the base of the largest rib lies an ancient offering cairn.

Someone placed a tiny carved Leviathan at its center.

Shizuki added nothing to the pile.

Her note explains why:

'Didn't feel right to take anything.

Didn't feel right to change anything either.

So I just sat here.'

right.message:
The oldest Gravekeeper forms beneath the rib.

For an instant, its shape resembles a living Leviathan before shrinking
into something the present Astral Sea can hold.

forward.message:
A clear current wells from beneath the ancient bones.

Beside it is Shizuki's last message in Leviathan's Wake:

'I thought this place would be scary.

A graveyard full of things this huge?

Yeah.

Very scary.

But I don't think it feels scary anymore.

It feels quiet.

Like they chose somewhere beautiful to rest.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the water untouched.

Nothing else needs to be said.

boss-antechamber.name: Cradle of the First Wake
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The ancient ribs open around an enormous hollow.

Every current in Leviathan's Wake seems to pass through this chamber
before flowing outward into the graveyard.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Cradle of the First Wake begins to glow.

Memories travel along the skeleton.

You see Moonlit currents from an age before Moonlit Reef had its name.

You see stars falling into what would someday become Starfall Trench.

You see forests far smaller than Whispering Kelp Forest.

And then you see them.

Leviathans.

Hundreds moving across an ancient Astral Sea.

At the center swims one larger than all the others.

Its image turns toward you.

Not alive.

Not resurrected.

Only the oldest memory this place still carries.

Use /yes to enter the Cradle of the First Wake or /no to leave the
first grave dreaming a little longer.

bossRetreatText:
You step away from the Cradle.

The enormous memory continues swimming through an ocean that disappeared
ages ago.

It does not follow.

boss.revealText:
The ancient current fills with starlight.

For one impossible moment, the entire skeleton is no longer bone.

A colossal Leviathan of memory swims through the chamber, vast enough
to make every creature you've faced in the Wake seem tiny.

The First Leviathan Echo awakens!

completionText:
The First Leviathan Echo swims once around the Cradle.

Then it dissolves into thousands of points of light.

They travel outward through the ribs.

Across the old spine.

Past the remembering scale.

Through the Wakeheart currents.

Across the wrecks, gardens, scars, jaws, and countless bones you passed
on the journey here.

For a moment, every skeleton in Leviathan's Wake glows.

Then the graveyard becomes quiet again.

Shizuki's final journal page rests beneath the oldest rib:

'We came here expecting monsters.

Instead we found a place where giants came to rest.

Glimmer says maybe that's why the currents never stopped moving.

Maybe the Wake is just the sea remembering where they used to swim.

...

There's something beyond the graveyard.

I can see towers in the distance.

Actual towers this time.

Not ribs.

Probably.

Glimmer already started going that way.

HEY—WAIT FOR ME!'

Far beyond the First Wake, the dark water gives way to distant stone.

Broken towers.

Old walls.

A crown-shaped silhouette beneath the sea.

The road toward Sunken King's Throne is open.

Leviathan's Wake is complete.
